name: Kingston Powerhouse
reason: Heritage power station housing Canberra Glassworks: Wikivoyage and VisitCanberra both name it; public hot shop and gallery to watch glassblowing, Wed-Sun (opened Wikivoyage South Canberra and VisitCanberra museums page).
objection: Partly a workshop/shop, and Wikivoyage entry is flagged a dead link; some may see it as a business.

name: Yarralumla Bay
reason: Lakeside bay named by VisitCanberra's attractions list (opened); second-tier lake foreshore with a paddle hub but no named thing to see beyond the shore.
objection: One source, thin description, no coordinates, may be a local foreshore.

name: Yarralumla Play Station
reason: Commercial family play venue: a business, not a place.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it, but it is an indoor play centre.

name: Canberra International Golf Centre
reason: Golf range/course is a club/commercial venue.
objection: Open to public, but a sports facility.

name: Canberra Public Golf Course
reason: Golf course is a sports venue/club, no visitor draw.

name: Axxe Urban Axe Throwing
reason: commercial venue/business, not a place (operators, clubs, shops, play venues rejected)

reason: Commercial art gallery in Fyshwick, one source, essentially a shop.

name: Grainger Gallery
reason: Commercial art gallery in Fyshwick, one source, essentially a shop.

name: Craft and Design Canberra
reason: Craft and design gallery (The Treasury) named on two VisitCanberra pages (opened); public gallery, free entry likely, but small.

name: Gallery of Small Things
reason: Quirky 'smallest gallery' in Watson, two VisitCanberra pages plus Wikivoyage; opens Thu-Sun only.

reason: Commercial aerial obstacle course operator: business, not a place.

name: Point Hut Pond Park

name: Telopea Park
reason: No counted source; local suburban park.

name: Haig Park
reason: Wikivoyage describes a windbreak of tree rows between two hills (opened); nothing to see or do beyond a local walk; the market is Sunday-only and an event.
objection: One counted source names it, and it is a long shelterbelt some might walk.

name: City Hill
reason: No counted source found; civic hill and roundabout park, nothing visitors go in for.

name: Corroboree Park
reason: No visitor source; local park.

name: Lennox Gardens
reason: No visitor source; small garden park in Parkes.

name: National Rose Gardens
reason: No visitor source; small rose garden beside Old Parliament House, part of the Parliamentary Triangle gardens.
objection: Roses are a draw in season.

name: Kings Park
reason: Wikivoyage (opened) gives Kings Park a section with six memorials and the Griffin plans; the National Capital Exhibition is the visit and may be its own candidate.
objection: Mostly minor memorials; a park of lawns beside Commonwealth Park; one source.

name: Gubur Dhaura
reason: Sacred site; visitor access not confirmed and no visitor source.

name: Canberra Peace Park
reason: No visitor source; small commemorative park.

name: Canberra Nature Park
reason: Umbrella for about 39 separate reserves; each reserve (Mount Ainslie, Black Mountain, Mulligans Flat) is judged on its own, so the container is not a single place.
objection: Parks ACT brands it as one park.

name: Canberra Centenary Trail
reason: 145 km signed loop entirely around Canberra, named by VisitCanberra's 100 things and cycling pages (opened cycling page) and listed by the parks agency (parks-act-leads, relied on); walkable by section.
objection: Very long linear route; sections overlap candidate hills and reserves.

name: Red Rocks Gorge
reason: Murrumbidgee gorge named by the parks agency pages (parks-act-leads list, relied on) and a walking guide; walk between Kambah Pool and Pine Island.
objection: One agency source; the walk may overlap Murrumbidgee River Corridor candidates; climbing closed.

name: Majura Pines
reason: Mountain-bike trail network named by VisitCanberra cycling page (opened); a place riders go.
objection: One source, an activity venue in a plantation, overlap with Treetops/Majura area.

name: Nanny Goat Hill Lookout
reason: No counted source and location not confirmed (ACT or NSW); cannot show it is in the region.

name: Marion Mahony Griffin Lookout
reason: No counted source and location not confirmed.

name: Royal Canberra Show
reason: Annual event, not there whenever one arrives.
objection: Two counted sources; Exhibition Park venue judged separately.
